en:
<CLT=cltMIND>Every time I come here, I play the
role of their "ideal." Like some shared fantasy.

<CLT=cltMIND>Maki's ideal fantasy...
I wonder what that could be like...
...Hey.
Ah...hey?

I still don't know anything...even after we've
been together for over 10 years.
10 years...?

Right before you entered elementary school,
you came to the orphanage...remember?
Ah, yes... I remember.

<CLT=cltMIND>I see...
Maki and I are friends from the orphanage.

<CLT=cltMIND>But she said that we were
together for over 10 years, right?

<CLT=cltMIND>Perhaps that means, in this fantasy...
Maki never became an assassin?

Hey, Maki. This might sound weird, but...
Have we been together all this time?

...Yes.
Why are you asking me weird questions?

<CLT=cltMIND>It doesn't seem like she's lying.
I suppose she really isn't an assassin.

<CLT=cltMIND>Well, if this is Maki's fantasy,
that means...

...What's up with you? 
You've been acting really strange lately.

<CLT=cltMIND>I have to pretend that I
don't know Maki is an assassin.

...Why are you looking at me like that?
Is it something I said?

...Why are you looking at me like that?
Is it something I said?
Ah, no, it's nothing...
*sigh*

I don't know why you're making that face.
I don't get you.

Do you think that you
*should*?

<CLT=cltMIND>...Did I say something?
Maki is blushing... What happened?

I...I didn't know you thought about things
like that... This whole time, I never noticed...
Things...like that...

Y-You... Y-You're the...worst...
You're the...worst ever...
<CLT=cltMIND>
What? Where did this come from?
Wh-What...are you trying to get me to say?

It's all because you said *that* when we played
House... The younger kids are copying us...

<CLT=cltMIND>I said something...?
What was it?

You're usually so...unreliable, but then you had
to say *that* all of a sudden... What a pain...

Y-You...said you didn't want to play House
anymore, but instead start a real family...

When did you start thinking about that?
I never even noticed it before...
I said *what*!?
That means...you and I...

Well...you must've said that seriously,
knowing the type of guy you are.

You don't lie...and you would never do
anything to make someone sad...

...I already know that. I wasn't with you 
for this long just for your looks.
That's why...I...

<CLT=cltMIND>Maki stopped pouring her heart
out and looked down.
Maki...? What's wrong?
...Give me your hand.
My hand? Like this?

<CLT=cltMIND>Maki squeezed her hands around mine
as if trying to envelop it.
This is...definitely strange.

When I think about you... 
When I hold your hand... When I touch you...

I'm happy, but I'm scared... I'm satisfied with
so little, but at the same time, I want more...

I don't understand... This is the first time...
I've ever felt this way...

<CLT=cltMIND>I felt Maki's hands
tighten around mine.
Hey, Shuichi...

There's still a lot I don't understand...
But I'm certain about some things.

I don't want to let you go. I'll stay by your
side forever, close enough to hold your hand.

I want to...cuddle...just the two of us. If this
is what families do...then I want to do that.
That's what it means to love...right?
Maki...

After you said you wanted to start a family,
I thought about it.

You're my friend from the orphanage...
You've always been there for me...
That's normal...but not, at the same time.

You think about me...I think about you, too...
We stayed together after all this time...

This is probably just a miracle...
But miracles turn to false hope eventually...
<CLT=cltMIND>Maki stared into my eyes.

<CLT=cltMIND>Her gaze was so serious, so resolute.
I felt it in my bones.

...I don't want to lose anything.
You...or this feeling...

That's why I want you to promise me.
Not just a marriage proposal...
But, something that lets me feel more...

<CLT=cltMIND>Maki had made her decision.
I needed to make mine.

<CLT=cltMIND>I took a breath to prepare my heart...
and nodded with a smile.
<CLT=cltMIND>.........
<CLT=cltMIND>......
<CLT=cltMIND>...
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>You've acquired a new theme, "Love Suite."
